hypotheses.S0_pure_semantic_and_answer_effect_direc: Across rho=0 seeds, unscaled semantic/answer finite-effect cosine remains >=0.90.
hypotheses.S1_discovery_calibrated_answer_delta_rec: Across rho=0 seeds, discovery-margin-calibrated answer deltas are within 0.05 semantic target accuracy and have median effect fidelity >=0.90 on held-out template-6 identities.
hypotheses.S2_norm_matching_is_sufficient: Across rho=0 seeds, activation-norm-matched answer deltas are within 0.10 semantic accuracy and have effect fidelity >=0.80.
hypotheses.S3_final_semantic_patch_is_output_verb_p: S0 and S1 pass, so the final-layer semantic patch needs no distinct effect direction beyond a calibrated generic output verb.
hypotheses.S4_mixed_semantic_failure_is_not_fixed_b: Across rho=0.5 seeds, calibrated answer effects remain at least 0.15 more accurate than semantic patches, indicating that semantic transfer—not the output interface—is missing.
